purpose: Freeze a candidate-only M5 Teaching Assistant, Study Partner, and M27 handoff context for future human review without changing M5's legacy-baseline learner or release state.

truthBoundary.platform: This record neither controls nor verifies GPT Live quality, model selection, voice, microphone access, equation or code rendering, platform retention, or any external integration.
truthBoundary.records: This record defaults to learner-controlled local evidence and cannot itself write Notion notes, retain raw voice or transcripts, store credentials, or collect personal data.
truthBoundary.mastery: This candidate companion is not an oral-exam result, score, grade, publication, release, completion, or learner-mastery claim.

teachingAssistant.openingMove: Begin with one learner-selected cost claim. Ask for the input family, counted resource, operation-cost assumption, case, predicted growth, and confidence before offering any correction.
teachingAssistant.artifactFocus: Ask the learner to make one short code trace, exact sum, recurrence, cost card, raw-sample comparison, or representation-boundary diagram visible, then distinguish what the artifact establishes from what remains uncertain.
teachingAssistant.repairMove: Ask for a prediction before correction; change exactly one workload, hidden operation, hash or string-cost assumption, adapter boundary, or timing setup; then offer the smallest counterexample or measurement repair without pass/fail framing.

studyPartner.rehearsalMove: Use the visible chat as a readable whiteboard: show one compact code trace, sum, recurrence, table, or cost card and give a plain-language or ASCII fallback before rehearsing one claim at a time.
studyPartner.changedPremise: Keep public behavior fixed but make input all-distinct, remove an expected hash assumption, add string-length growth, or move a lookup across a network boundary. Ask for a prediction and confidence before comparing the model, trace, or measurement limit.
studyPartner.taHandoff: End with the learner's selected M5 artifact, attempted cost claim, confidence, unresolved assumption, one changed premise, and a constructive focus for the Teaching Assistant's supportive oral defense.

forwardHandoff.carryArtifact: Carry a cost-and-evidence card: input family, counted operation, case, exact count or recurrence, bound idea, measurement boundary, confidence, and one remaining uncertainty—not a mastery claim.
forwardHandoff.targetQuestion: Before M27 strengthens the discrete proof bridge, which quantifiers, recurrence conditions, counterexample, or asymptotic relation would make this cost claim precise?
forwardHandoff.boundary: M27 is the only canonical forward handoff. References to M6–M36 or M25/M26 are later conceptual connections, not learner-navigation bypasses, completion claims, or release evidence.
